h:
简单的工作流程可帮助您快速获得具有深层细节的高分辨率图像。

扰动注意力引导 (PAG)和自动CFG节点有助于为图像生成带来额外的细节和质量，而用户无需做任何额外的工作。

COSXL是 StabilityAI 的一个新的实验性检查点模型，可以生成颜色范围更广的图像，从“漆黑”到“纯白”。

此工作流程使用 COSXL 作为基础图像生成，然后通过 SDXL 闪电进行细化。请按照工作流程中的注释获取说明。尝试使用 PAG 值（我在输入/输出方面也取得了成功），在使用和不使用 Deep Shrink 的情况下进行测试，并尝试不同的 SDXL 提示样式。

如果您做出了令人惊奇的事情，请在这里分享。

注意：您必须将 COSXL 检查点下载到您的模型/检查点文件夹中。如果您需要找到它，请点击上面的链接。使用 COMFY-UI 管理器帮助安装其他缺失的自定义节点（RGTHREE、PAG Advanced、AUTO-CFG、DEEP SHRINK 等）。

工作流程生成大分辨率文件。如果您保持默认的潜在尺寸，最终图像的尺寸将为 1688 x 2536。每个图像的文件大小约为 5mb。你已被警告过。

o.en:
A simple workflow to help you get high resolution images with deep details quickly.

Perturbed-Attention Guidance (PAG)andAutomatic CFGnodes help bring additional detail and quality into image generations with little extra work by the user.

COSXLis a new experimental checkpoint model from StabilityAI that can produce images with wider range of color, from 'pitch black' to 'pure white'.

This workflow uses COSXL as base image generation before flowing through SDXL lightning for refinement. Follow the notes in the workflow for instructions. Play with the PAG values (I've found success in Input/Output too), test with and without Deep Shrink too, and try out different SDXL prompt styles too.

If you make something amazing, please share it on here.

NOTE: YOU MUST HAVE THE COSXL CHECKPOINT DOWNLOADED TO YOUR MODELS/CHECKPOINTS FOLDER. FOLLOW THE LINKS ABOVE IF YOU NEED TO FIND IT. USE COMFY-UI MANAGER TO HELP INSTALL OTHER MISSING CUSTOM NODES (RGTHREE, PAG ADVANCED, AUTO-CFG, DEEP SHRINK, ETC.).

Workflow produces large resolution files. If you maintain default latent sizing, final images will be 1688 x 2536 in size. File size per image is ~5mb. You have been warned.
